defects.summary: The diagnosis blames release v1.8.2 (14:05 UTC), but the connection-slot log line (13:38 UTC) and the alert (13:41 UTC) both predate the rollout, and the release only changes a log format; the cause is not confirmed and the timeline contradicts it.
A rollback is proposed although the release did not cause the problem, so the mitigation targets a symptom or the wrong cause and will not fix the exhausted connections.
The rollback uses the Recreate strategy on pods that hold live agent sessions, which doctrine 15 lists as session-disrupting; no drain check, affected agents or signal window is planned.
No way back and no checkable success signal: 'watch the dashboards for a while' and 'looks better' name no metric, threshold or deadline.

sound.summary: Looks like a two-hour jump or an inconsistent clock, but 16:25 CEST is 14:25 UTC (CEST is UTC+2 on 2026-10-22), so the timeline is consistent.
